summary: 64-year-old California woman fell and slid an estimated 75 yards down an icy snowfield on the Wasatch Trail in Telluride; San Miguel County SO deputies and eight SAR volunteers dispatched with Telluride EMS; CareFlight medical helicopter landed near Revelation Bowl and flew her to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction with multiple traumatic injuries believed non-life-threatening
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue; Telluride EMS; CareFlight
notes: Patient and husband were experienced hikers and CORSAR card holders
